pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Nuvio Desktop is a Compose-Multiplatform media player: it browses Nuvio addons and plays through libmpv.
This is a -bin package. Upstream builds a jpackage tree (bundled JRE under /opt/nuvio/lib/runtime) and publishes it as .deb/.rpm/.AppImage/ .flatpak; the release .deb is unpacked and the tree installed verbatim under /opt, with upstream's own .desktop file and a /usr/bin/nuvio symlink added.
Upstream's in-app updater cannot install anything here, by design: on Linux it only offers self-installation when it detects an AppImage (APPIMAGE env), a Flatpak sandbox, or a dpkg/rpm-owned launcher, and it has no sudo/pkexec path. A Portage install is UNKNOWN to it, so updates come from this ebuild: bump PV, refresh the Manifest, emerge.
